# _ctl/tests/fixtures/pin-coverage/classification.txt — the answer a healthy
# `SMOKE_LIST_PINS=1 bash .ci/smoke.sh <image>` gives for pins.env.
#
# 1 record per pin: <NAME>|<class>. The 3 classes are the whole taxonomy:
#
#   asserted           the smoke runs the tool and compares the version it reports
#   not-a-version      the pin is a digest, a package name or a branch
#   not-in-this-image  the image does not install the tool
#
# The test compares this list with the pin file. It never checks WHICH class a
# pin carries — that is the choice of .ci/smoke.sh. It checks that every pin
# carries exactly 1 class, and that no class names a pin that is not there.
GH_VERSION|asserted
HNSLINT_VERSION|asserted
TERRAFORM_VERSION|not-in-this-image
DOCKER_COMPOSE_SHA256_AMD64|not-a-version
PYTHON_PACKAGE|not-a-version
